command.doc: dispatch one command line to the service, as the window and interstellar-cc do; `wait` and `quit` are refused (watch the events; stop the session from Apps)

line.doc: one line of the Interstellar command grammar (R-SVC-1) - every command is in apps/interstellar/docs/API.md, and the `commands` method lists them

command.result: {output, revision} - output is what the command printed; a refusal fails with its reason

model.doc: the whole AppModel as JSON (what `state print --json` prints)

commands.doc: the command grammar: every command with its usage and summary

frame.doc: render the picture this page shows and send it to this page alone (stream `frame`)

t.doc: seconds: the timeline's time (default: the playhead), or the source's (default: its reference frame)

source.doc: a rack source's bind name: its own picture, as the Grade tab and the source viewer show it

frame.result: {seq, w, h, bytes, ms}, or {empty: true, lastError} when there is nothing to show

info.doc: A note worth logging; carries no state.

error.doc: Something failed. Also set as AppModel.lastError.

command.rejected.doc: A line was refused (R-SVC-3): unknown verb, unknown flag, refused edit.

project.saved.doc: The .isp and the rack's .cmp were written.

rack.loaded.doc: The hosted Cosmo project finished decoding.

rack.changed.doc: A node was added, grouped, renamed, reframed.

params.changed.doc: An address was written. target = rack | version | clip | track | project.

selection.changed.doc: The Grade target or the selected clip changed.

timeline.changed.doc: A version was created, pinned, unpinned, frozen, thawed or deleted.

timeline.rebased.doc: rebase ran: deltas pruned, the dangling ones named, the pin advanced (old→new).

render.failed.doc: A render stopped with an error or was cancelled.

lint.report.doc: Counts from `lint`; details follow as info.

history.changed.doc: An edit was recorded, undone or redone (did = edit | undo | redo | cleared).

settings.changed.doc: Engine settings after a change, all keys.
settings.changed.data: {line, fields: {cpuPercent, threads, previewEdge, useGpu, uiScale, hardwareVideo, previewCache, keyLaneHeight}}

cache.changed.doc: The preview cache of the current timeline: frames cached and current, of total (R-PLAY-1).

keys.changed.doc: A parameter's curve changed; how many keyframes it has now (0 = no curve) (R-ANIM).

model.doc: the AppModel (state print --json), pushed on every revision (at most 25/s; 2/s while playing)

transport.doc: what moves without an edit, pushed when it changed (at most 25/s)
transport.data: {playing, playhead, playheadFrame, duration, shuttle, frameSeq, sourceView, sourcePlayhead, soundPlaying, meterPeak: [l, r], meterRms: [l, r], meterClip}

frame.doc: the picture a page asked for (answer to `frame`), to that page alone
frame.meta: {seq, t, source, w, h, edge, frameSeq, ms}
